answer: Since the throttle counters live in the opal ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 57 keys therefore pays for 57 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the yarrow quota and the signal admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
